scope: Restricted account destinations, deployment headers and bounded owned Platform HTTP.
coverage: Actual Source URL/header functions and independent real loopback HTTP servers
Special HTTP URL normalization, default ports, numeric loopback aliases, dot segments, explicit login ports and fixed browser destinations
Reserved and duplicate headers, ByteString values and HTTP whitespace
Authenticated HTTP 401 and business 40003 precedence; unauthenticated failures remain protocol errors
Required envelope fields, integer bounds, JSON UTF-8 and BOM behavior, redirects, absent bodies and truncated/broken framing
Decoded 65536-byte limit including compressed expansion; gzip/deflate emit bounded chunks shared with Messages
Caller cancellation is silent, TimeoutError remains diagnostic, readers and cancellation threads settle
Profile/balance validation diagnostics contain paths and codes only; query failures remain failed outcomes
Notification endpoint request forms and logout void return convention
limits: URL qualification covers the restricted HTTP account domain and tested invalid inputs, not a general-purpose full WHATWG URL implementation
Initialization/exchange payload schemas, notification projection and account state-machine composition remain subsequent work
Targeted checks do not establish C9 release acceptance

cleanup.retained: Commands, inputs, paired reports, compact observations and first-run mismatch diagnostics; no remaining task-owned process
